description: PROP-AUTH-018 claims to verify 'callback Set-Cookie for __Host-link_session has exact attributes' (REQ-AUTH-005). However, the test at auth-flow.test.ts:276-288 does NOT test Set-Cookie header attributes at all. It merely calls saveDiscordLinkSession and asserts that the store count increased. The test description says 'Set-Cookie for __Host-link_session has exact attributes' but the assertions only check getStoreCounts().linkSessions > 0. This is a mislabeled test: it tests storage insertion, not cookie serialization or Set-Cookie header attributes. The handleAuthRequest function for '/v1/auth/discord/callback' at shell/index.ts:147-149 does not even issue a Set-Cookie header for __Host-link_session. REQ-AUTH-005 requires Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Path=/; Max-Age=900 with no Domain attribute, but no integration test verifies these attributes for the link session cookie.
